svg.title: Seven-night pet-care totals from dated nightly rates
svg.desc: Bars for seven-night totals: Dogs Reformed mid suite 280 dollars, Rover Toronto boarding 350 dollars, Rover Toronto house sitting about 371 dollars, and Kamp K-9 Mississauga 406 dollars before HST.
svg.text: Seven nights, before a holiday add-on
Nightly rate times 7. Kamp K-9 is before HST. Rover house sitting is about 53 dollars times 7.

g.text: Dogs Reformed mid suite, Stoney Creek

svg.text: Scale: 406 dollars = 379 px. 280/406 times 379 is 261 px. 350/406 times 379 is 327 px. 371/406 times 379 is 346 px.
Rover boarding as of Aug 2025, 50 dollars including service fees. The page also says one week is typically 350 dollars.
House sitting as of Jun 2026, about 53 dollars after fees. Do not add the 11 percent booking fee a second time.
Kamp K-9 prints plus HST. At 13 percent, seven nights are 458.78 dollars. That tax total is not the bar.
A statutory holiday at Kamp K-9 is 10 dollars plus HST for that day. It is not included above.
Drop-in visits are 25 dollars median per visit, not per night, so they are not a bar.
Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026. Recheck the checkout screen. A median is not your sitter's price.
